name: extract-ready-pattern
description:
A ready regular expression, found anywhere in a phrase, case-sensitive.

kind: "domain" (Latin domains with subdomains: «www.example.com»; extract gives all, joined by a space), "email" (the first e-mail), "phone" (Russian numbers from +7 or 8: «8 (999) 123-45-67»; all, joined by ", "), "date_ddmmyyyy" (the first date as 05.11.2023, 05-11-2023, 05/11/2023 or 05112023) or "date_yyyymmdd" (as 2023-11-05 … 20231105). A date has the same separator twice, or none, and is never part of a longer number; its day and month are not checked (39.19.2999 is found).

find marks where the pattern is; remove cuts out every match; extract keeps what is said above, an empty cell where there is none.

extract-ready-pattern keeps only what the matcher finds in the working column; an empty cell where it finds nothing.

Example: semkit read core.csv extract-ready-pattern domain write out.csv
